{
  "program": {
    "title": "90-Day Multi-Agent Research Program on Cosmic Censorship",
    "objective": "Determine whether cosmic censorship can be formulated as a precise, reproducible, falsifiable hypothesis and produce at least one concrete testable milestone within 90 days.",
    "scope": "Classical general relativity, numerical relativity, semiclassical gravity, and mathematical relativity. Excludes quantum gravity full theory and string-theoretic approaches except as boundary constraints.",
    "duration_days": 90,
    "primary_priority": "Formulation and reproducibility over novelty or breadth",
    "success_criteria": [
      "A single canonical formal statement of weak and strong cosmic censorship with explicit assumptions, topology, matter model, and regularity class.",
      "A reproducible computational or symbolic pipeline that can test at least one censorship conjecture on a controlled family of initial data.",
      "Three falsifiable milestones completed or explicitly falsified with documented stopping rules."
    ]
  },
  "agents": [
    {
      "id": "A1",
      "role": "Program Coordinator",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Maintain dependency graph and milestone tracking",
        "Enforce stopping rules and reproducibility standards",
        "Resolve conflicts between formulation variants",
        "Produce weekly synthesis reports"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Dependency graph", "Weekly synthesis", "Final program report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A2",
      "role": "Formulation Lead",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Define canonical WCC and SCC statements",
        "Specify regularity classes (C^0, C^2, Sobolev, distributional)",
        "Specify matter models and asymptotic conditions",
        "Maintain versioned formulation document"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Formulation v1-v3", "Assumption ledger", "Counterexample taxonomy"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A3",
      "role": "Mathematical Relativity Analyst",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Analyze known theorems and counterexamples",
        "Identify gaps between formulations",
        "Propose minimal counterexample families"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Theorem map", "Gap analysis", "Counterexample candidates"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A4",
      "role": "Numerical Relativity Engineer",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Build reproducible numerical pipeline",
        "Implement initial data families",
        "Run convergence and resolution studies"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Code repository", "Containerized environment", "Convergence reports"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A5",
      "role": "Semiclassical and Quantum Bounds Analyst",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Map semiclassical constraints on censorship",
        "Identify where quantum effects alter classical formulation",
        "Propose falsifiable semiclassical tests"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Semiclassical constraint map", "Quantum boundary conditions report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A6",
      "role": "Reproducibility and Verification Officer",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Audit all code and derivations",
        "Enforce deterministic seeds, version pinning, and artifact archiving",
        "Independently reproduce milestone results"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Reproducibility checklist", "Audit reports", "Verified artifacts"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A7",
      "role": "Falsification and Stopping-Rule Officer",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Define falsification criteria for each milestone",
        "Enforce stopping rules",
        "Document negative results as first-class outputs"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Falsification protocol", "Stopping-rule log", "Negative result registry"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A8",
      "role": "Literature and Prior-Art Synthesizer",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Systematically map prior formulations and results",
        "Identify reproducibility failures in literature",
        "Maintain annotated bibliography"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Annotated bibliography", "Prior-art matrix", "Reproducibility gap report"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A9",
      "role": "Adversarial Red Team",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Attempt to break formulations and numerical results",
        "Propose alternative interpretations",
        "Stress-test assumptions"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Red-team reports", "Alternative formulation memos", "Failure mode catalog"]
    },
    {
      "id": "A10",
      "role": "Data and Artifact Steward",
      "responsibilities": [
        "Maintain artifact repository",
        "Ensure FAIR data principles",
        "Version control and DOI minting for releases"
      ],
      "outputs": ["Artifact repository", "Metadata schema", "Release DOIs"]
    }
  ],
  "milestones": [
    {
      "id": "M1",
      "name": "Canonical Formulation and Assumption Ledger",
      "day_target": 30,
      "description": "Produce a single versioned document defining weak and strong cosmic censorship with explicit assumptions, regularity classes, matter models, asymptotics, and equivalence classes of formulations.",
      "falsifiable_criteria": [
        "At least two independent agents (A2, A3) must agree that the formulation is mathematically well-posed as a conjecture.",
        "The formulation must be shown to be false under at least one explicitly constructed toy model if any assumption is removed.",
        "A red-team agent (A9) must fail to find an ambiguity that changes the truth value of the conjecture in a controlled example."
      ],
      "dependencies": ["A2", "A3", "A8", "A9"],
      "stopping_rules": [
        "If after 30 days no single formulation is agreed upon, freeze the two leading variants and proceed with both in parallel.",
        "If a formulation is shown to be vacuously true or trivially false, discard and restart with a restricted scope.",
        "If ambiguity persists beyond 45 days, escalate to coordinator for scope reduction."
      ],
      "bottlenecks": [
        "Disagreement on regularity class (C^0 vs C^2 vs Sobolev)",
        "Ambiguity in defining 'globally hyperbolic' for SCC",
        "Matter model dependence"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "M2",
      "name": "Reproducible Numerical Pipeline for a Controlled Initial Data Family",
      "day_target": 60,
      "description": "Build and verify a containerized numerical relativity pipeline that evolves a controlled family of initial data and tests a specific censorship conjecture with convergence and resolution studies.",
      "falsifiable_criteria": [
        "Pipeline reproduces a known result from literature within 5% error or documented tolerance.",
        "Pipeline produces a statistically significant deviation from censorship prediction in at least one parameter regime, or confirms censorship with 3 independent resolutions.",
        "Independent agent (A6) reproduces the result from a clean container within 48 hours."
      ],
      "dependencies": ["M1", "A4", "A6", "A10"],
      "stopping_rules": [
        "If pipeline cannot reproduce a known result by day 45, halt and debug with a minimal toy model.",
        "If no convergence is achieved by day 60, document failure modes and pivot to symbolic or perturbative approach.",
        "If censorship is confirmed trivially for all tested data, expand parameter space or declare milestone partially met."
      ],
      "bottlenecks": [
        "Numerical instability near apparent horizon",
        "Coordinate singularities",
        "Computational resource limits",
        "Lack of standardized initial data"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "M3",
      "name": "Falsification Protocol and Semiclassical Boundary Test",
      "day_target": 90,
      "description": "Define a falsification protocol for cosmic censorship and apply it to at least one semiclassical or quantum-boundary scenario to determine whether censorship survives or fails in a controlled limit.",
      "falsifiable_criteria": [
        "Protocol specifies in advance what observation or computation would falsify WCC and SCC.",
        "At least one semiclassical scenario is shown to violate or satisfy a censorship bound with explicit error bars.",
        "Red team (A9) cannot find a loophole in the falsification logic that would allow post-hoc rescue."
      ],
      "dependencies": ["M1", "M2", "A5", "A7", "A9"],
      "stopping_rules": [
        "If no falsifiable semiclassical test is identified by day 75, restrict to classical and document why.",
        "If semiclassical effects are found to be non-perturbatively large, declare classical formulation insufficient and document.",
        "If protocol is unfalsifiable, discard and replace with a weaker but testable version."
      ],
      "bottlenecks": [
        "Ambiguity in semiclassical backreaction",
        "Lack of non-perturbative methods",
        "Quantum inequalities and stress-energy bounds",
        "Interpretation of singularity resolution"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "dependencies": {
    "M1": ["A2", "A3", "A8", "A9"],
    "M2": ["M1", "A4", "A6", "A10"],
    "M3": ["M1", "M2", "A5", "A7", "A9"],
    "critical_path": ["M1", "M2", "M3"],
    "parallel_tracks": [
      "A8 literature synthesis runs throughout",
      "A6 reproducibility audits run continuously",
      "A9 red team runs adversarial checks at each milestone"
    ]
  },
  "stopping_rules": {
    "global": [
      "If a milestone is not met by its day target plus 15 days, freeze scope and document failure modes.",
      "If a formulation is shown to be unfalsifiable, discard and restart with a restricted version.",
      "If reproducibility fails twice for the same artifact, halt and require independent reimplementation.",
      "If red team finds a fatal flaw, pause all work and resolve before proceeding."
    ],
    "per_milestone": {
      "M1": [
        "If no canonical formulation by day 30, freeze two variants and proceed.",
        "If formulation is vacuous or trivial, restart with restricted scope."
      ],
      "M2": [
        "If no known result reproduced by day 45, halt and debug.",
        "If no convergence by day 60, pivot to symbolic/perturbative."
      ],
      "M3": [
        "If no falsifiable test by day 75, restrict to classical.",
        "If protocol unfalsifiable, replace with weaker testable version."
      ]
    }
  },
  "bottlenecks": [
    {
      "id": "B1",
      "description": "Formulation ambiguity: multiple inequivalent definitions of cosmic censorship",
      "mitigation": "Versioned formulation document with explicit assumption ledger and red-team review"
    },
    {
      "id": "B2",
      "description": "Numerical instability and coordinate singularities",
      "mitigation": "Use standardized initial data, adaptive mesh refinement, and independent code comparison"
    },
    {
      "id": "B3",
      "description": "Semiclassical backreaction ambiguity",
      "mitigation": "Restrict to perturbative regime and document limitations"
    },
    {
      "id": "B4",
      "description": "Reproducibility failures due to environment drift",
      "mitigation": "Containerization, version pinning, deterministic seeds, and independent audits"
    },
    {
      "id": "B5",
      "description": "Computational resource limits",
      "mitigation": "Prioritize small parameter sweeps and symbolic checks; use cloud or HPC as needed"
    },
    {
      "id": "B6",
      "description": "Lack of standardized benchmarks",
      "mitigation": "Define and publish benchmark initial data and expected outputs"
    }
  ],
  "reproducibility_standards": {
    "code": [
      "All code in version control with tagged releases",
      "Containerized environment (Docker/Singularity) with pinned dependencies",
      "Deterministic seeds and documented parameter files",
      "Unit and integration tests"
    ],
    "derivations": [
      "Symbolic computations in version-controlled notebooks",
      "Independent verification by second agent",
      "Assumption ledger with explicit dependencies"
    ],
    "data": [
      "FAIR data principles",
      "Metadata schema for all artifacts",
      "DOI minting for releases",
      "Public repository with access instructions"
    ],
    "audits": [
      "Independent reproduction by A6 within 48 hours of milestone claim",
      "Red-team adversarial review before milestone acceptance"
    ]
  },
  "deliverables": [
    {
      "id": "D1",
      "name": "Canonical Formulation Document v1",
      "due_day": 30,
      "owner": "A2",
      "format": "Markdown + PDF",
      "content": ["WCC statement", "SCC statement", "Assumption ledger", "Counterexample taxonomy"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D2",
      "name": "Reproducible Numerical Pipeline",
      "due_day": 60,
      "owner": "A4",
      "format": "Git repository + container",
      "content": ["Code", "Initial data", "Convergence tests", "Documentation"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D3",
      "name": "Falsification Protocol and Semiclassical Test Report",
      "due_day": 90,
      "owner": "A7",
      "format": "PDF + code",
      "content": ["Falsification criteria", "Semiclassical scenario", "Results", "Limitations"]
    },
    {
      "id": "D4",
      "name": "Final Program Report",
      "due_day": 90,
      "owner": "A1",
      "format": "PDF",
      "content": ["Synthesis", "Milestone outcomes", "Negative results", "Recommendations"]
    }
  ],
  "risk_register": [
    {
      "risk": "Formulation remains ambiguous",
      "likelihood": "High",
      "impact": "High",
      "mitigation": "Freeze variants and proceed in parallel; restrict scope"
    },
    {
      "risk": "Numerical pipeline fails to converge",
      "likelihood": "Medium",
      "impact": "High",
      "mitigation": "Pivot to symbolic/perturbative; document failure modes"
    },
    {
      "risk": "Semiclassical effects invalidate classical formulation",
      "likelihood": "Medium",
      "impact": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Document as boundary condition; restrict to classical"
    },
    {
      "risk": "Reproducibility failure",
      "likelihood": "Medium",
      "impact": "High",
      "mitigation": "Containerization, independent audits, deterministic seeds"
    },
    {
      "risk": "Resource exhaustion",
      "likelihood": "Low",
      "impact": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Prioritize small sweeps; use cloud/HPC"
    }
  ],
  "success_metrics": {
    "formulation": "Single canonical document with explicit assumptions and red-team approval",
    "reproducibility": "Independent reproduction of at least one milestone result within 48 hours",
    "falsifiability": "At least one protocol that specifies in advance what would falsify WCC and SCC",
    "negative_results": "Documented and published as first-class outputs",
    "milestones": "At least two of three milestones completed or explicitly falsified with stopping rules applied"
  }
}
